details: Geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran have escalated, contributing to a "risk-off" sentiment across financial markets. This follows Iran's suspension of negotiations with the U.S. in protest of Israeli military actions in Lebanon. Concurrently, a significant Bitcoin sale by a major corporate holder, Strategy, which sold 32 BTC between May 26 and May 31, has added further pressure. These combined factors have led to Bitcoin's price dropping towards $70,000, marking a multi-week low and triggering over $1 billion in liquidations across the cryptocurrency market. Rising oil prices, typically associated with geopolitical conflicts, also tend to create headwinds for non-yielding assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: US-Iran Tensions & Major Bitcoin Sale Drive Crypto Market Down
